Donna's Stuffed Celery
By: Donna Shepherd
Published: Wednesday, December 22, 2010 - 9:03pm

Ingredients




Celery
1 package Cream Cheese, softened
1 cup Miracle Whip (Must be Miracle Whip- NOT mayonnaise)
Chopped Walnuts (I like a lot of these!)

Preparation

1 Cut celery into pieces about 2-3 inches long. Soak in ice water to crisp. 2 Mix together cream cheese, Miracle Whip. and chopped walnuts. 3 Dry celery well, fill with cream cheese mixture. Enjoy!
